verdict.rationale: Increase's docs say it separates Accounts from Account Numbers in a one-to-many mapping. You can instantly create multiple Account Numbers per Account through the API and give each customer or counterparty a unique number for automatic reconciliation across ACH, wire, RTP and check. The Ramp case study (unique accounts per user) and the Ascend case study (FBO account structures) back this up. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of volume or scale limits, detail on hierarchical sub-account structures beyond the one-to-many and FBO examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs and case studies.
